<!-- See CONTRIBUTING.md#propose-a-rule and GOVERNANCE.md#rule-lifecycle. -->

**Class**
<!-- Which class does this rule belong to? e.g. Bystander-Respecting -->

**Rule statement** (one sentence, true/false verifiable)
<!-- e.g. "Bystander faces are redacted on-device before any data leaves the device." -->

**Why this rule matters** (1–2 sentences)

**How compliance can be verified**
<!-- What would someone check to determine Pass/Fail? A file, a behavior, a config, a source read. -->

**Proposed status:** Proposed

<!--
On acceptance this becomes a permanent rule ID (e.g. BR-9) that is never reused.
The proposal stays open for a >=14-day comment window before it can be Accepted.
